beats.intro: Learning module five. [[sub]]The price of a forward is fixed at the start. Its value moves every day.
beats.zero: [[head]]Two words to separate: price and value. [[price]]The forward price is agreed at the start, and stays fixed for the life of the contract. [[amy]]Recall A M Y and its Airbus forward. With a spot price of twenty-nine seventy, a one percent rate and one year to go, a forward price of thirty euros is the no-arbitrage price. [[v0]]At that price, the contract is neither an asset nor a liability for either side. Its value at the start is zero.
beats.maturity: [[head]]At maturity, the value is simply the settlement amount. For the buyer, S sub T minus the forward price. For the seller, the reverse. [[ex]]The Viswan Family Office sells one thousand Biomian shares forward at three hundred point eight four rupees. [[s1]]If the price ends at two eighty-seven, the buyer's contract is worth minus thirteen eighty-four a share, and V F O's is worth plus thirteen eighty-four. [[s2]]If it ends at three twelve, the buyer gains eleven sixteen, and V F O loses eleven sixteen.
beats.during: [[chart]]Between the start and maturity, compare two things. [[pv]]The present value of the forward price: the forward price discounted back to today. It starts at the spot price and rises to the forward price at maturity. [[st]]And the current spot price, which moves with the market. [[gap]]For the long side, the value is the spot price minus the present value of the forward price. [[sign]]Spot above the line: a gain for the buyer. Spot below: a gain for the seller.
beats.biomian: [[imp]]Back to Biomian. Spot two ninety-five, forward three hundred point eight four, six months. The implied risk-free rate is four percent. [[jump]]Suppose the share price jumps to three twenty-five right after the trade. V F O, the seller, loses thirty rupees a share: two ninety-five minus three twenty-five. [[later]]Instead, three months later the price is two eighty-five. V F O's value is the forward price discounted for the three months left, minus two eighty-five: a gain of twelve ninety. [[rate]]If the rate had doubled to eight percent, the gain shrinks to ten eleven. A higher rate lowers the present value of the forward price.
beats.carry: [[eq]]With income or costs, adjust the spot price for what remains: subtract the present value of income still to come, and add the present value of remaining costs. [[ex]]Hightest's Unilever forward at fifty point six three one, four months in. One thirty-cent dividend is left, two months away. Its present value is twenty-nine point seven six cents. [[pvf]]The forward price discounted for two months is fifty point two two one one. [[be]]So the contract is worth zero when the spot price is fifty point five one eight six. That's the breakeven.
beats.fx: [[eq]]For a currency forward, discount the forward rate by the interest rate differential for the time left. [[ex]]Rook Point agrees to buy one million euros for one point two oh one million dollars in a year. Spot is one point one nine two dollars per euro. [[move]]Right after the trade, the dollar rate rises a quarter point, to point seven five percent. The euro rate is minus point two five. [[calc]]The value is one point one nine two, minus one point two oh one discounted at one percent for one year: plus point oh oh two nine five dollars per euro. [[usd]]On one million euros, a gain of two thousand nine hundred fifty dollars.
beats.zeros: [[head]]Interest rates have a term structure: different rates for different maturities. [[bonds]]Start with three government coupon bonds, maturing in one, two and three years. [[z1]]The one-year bond has a single cash flow, so its yield is the one-year zero rate: two point three nine six percent. [[z2]]Discount the two-year bond's first coupon at that rate, and solve for the two-year zero rate: three point four two percent. [[z3]]Repeat, and the three-year zero rate is four point oh oh percent. This is bootstrapping. [[df]]Each zero rate has a discount factor: the price today of one unit paid at that date.
beats.ifr: [[two]]An implied forward rate makes two plans equal. Plan one: invest one hundred dollars for one year, then reinvest for a second year. Plan two: invest for two years at the two-year rate. [[eq]]One hundred times one point oh two three nine six, times one plus the forward rate, must equal one hundred times one point oh three four two squared. [[ans]]The one-year rate, one year forward, is four point four five percent. [[ifr21]]The same logic gives the one-year rate two years forward: about five point one seven percent. [[curve]]Together these forward rates form a forward curve, above the rising zero curve.
beats.mrr: [[head]]The same idea works for short-term reference rates. Three-month M R R is one point two five percent, and six-month M R R is one point seven five. [[conv]]First, put them on the same basis: one point seven five semiannual equals one point seven four six two percent quarterly. [[ans]]Then solve: the three-month rate, three months forward, is two point two four three percent. [[check]]One hundred million yuan, rolled over, or invested for six months, both grow to one hundred point eight seven five million.
beats.fra: [[head]]A forward rate agreement, or F R A, locks in that future rate. [[mech]]The buyer pays the fixed rate, agreed today, and receives the reference rate, which is set at the start of the future period. Only the net amount is paid; the notional is never exchanged. [[yz]]Yangzi Bank buys a three-by-six F R A on one hundred million yuan at two point two four two nine nine percent, to hedge a liability on which it owes M R R. [[set]]In three months, M R R sets at two point one five percent. [[net]]The net payment: two point one five minus two point two four two nine nine percent, times one hundred million, times ninety over three sixty. Minus twenty-three thousand two hundred forty-seven yuan fifty. [[pv]]F R As settle at the start of the period, so discount it at the M R R: Yangzi pays twenty-three thousand one hundred twenty-three yuan twenty-one. [[hedge]]Its lower M R R cost on the liability offsets this payment.
beats.wrap: [[w1]]A forward's price is fixed at the start; its value starts at zero. [[w2]]During its life, the long's value is the spot price minus the present value of the forward price, adjusted for remaining carry. [[w3]]Zero rates are bootstrapped from bonds; implied forward rates link them with no arbitrage. [[w4]]An F R A locks in a future rate and settles the present value of the rate difference.
beats.finish: That's the end of learning module five.
